datasets.source_name: NOAA Climate Prediction Center / Physical Sciences Laboratory

variables.name: oni_index
variables.definition: 3-month running mean of ERSST.v5 SST anomalies in the Niño 3.4 region (5°N–5°S, 120°–170°W).

datasets.license_usage_notes: Public domain (US Government work / NOAA NCEI open data)
datasets.processing_notes: Parsed from monthly fixed-width table, filtered to panel observation years, aggregated to annual calendar-year mean.

variables.name: rainfall_mm
variables.definition: Sum of daily precipitation at geographic centroids of Indian agricultural states.

variables.name: avg_temperature_c
variables.definition: Average 2-meter air temperature over the calendar year.

datasets.license_usage_notes: Follow Open-Meteo and underlying provider terms. The current API query does not pin an ERA5 model; do not label the saved series as ERA5-only without verification.
datasets.processing_notes: Queried per state centroid coordinates with Asia/Kolkata timezone. Both rainfall and temperature are used in the restored default benchmark.

datasets.source_name: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Climate Research & Services, Pune

variables.name: rainfall_mm
variables.full_name: Annual rainfall at nearest 1-degree grid cell to state centroid
variables.definition: Sum of official IMD daily gridded rainfall for a single cell near each state centroid; not an area-weighted state mean.

datasets.license_usage_notes: IMD publishes the data and citation guidance on its download page; retain attribution and consult IMD terms for redistribution.
datasets.processing_notes: Optional comparison source, not the default benchmark. Annual NetCDF files downloaded by scripts/download_imd_rainfall.py; nearest-cell selection, missing-value validation, and calendar-year sum. Per-file SHA-256 checksums in imd_rainfall_provenance.json.

datasets.source_name: Bundled agricultural GDP reference panel (unverified sample)

variables.name: agricultural_gva_cr
variables.definition: Locally bundled state-year reference values; primary RBI/MoSPI table, units, and methodology have not been verified.

datasets.license_usage_notes: Bundled project sample; do not represent it as official RBI/MoSPI GSVA.
datasets.processing_notes: Loaded from a local CSV and linked on (state, year). The repeated cross-state value pattern requires replacement with a traceable official economic series before substantive interpretation.
